_note: Ready-made training sessions (GDD D25). load = fatigue added (before durability). effects = training stimulus per attribute; several sessions on the same attribute in one week give diminishing returns. needs_track: needs a running track; in the months the outdoor track is closed, athletes without an indoor hall do it on roads/snow at reduced effect. months: only possible in these months (e.g. skiing needs snow).

sessions.name: Easy run
sessions.description: 30–40 min at a relaxed, chatty pace.

sessions.name: Fartlek
sessions.description: 40 min on forest trails with free surges.

sessions.name: Tempo run
sessions.description: 3 × 8 min at a comfortably hard pace.

sessions.name: 800 m intervals
sessions.description: 6 × 300 m fast with long recoveries. Race-specific and very hard.

sessions.name: Speed & strides
sessions.description: Flying 30 m sprints and relaxed strides on the straight.

sessions.name: Hill sprints
sessions.description: 8 × 10 s uphill, walk back down to recover.

sessions.name: Start practice
sessions.description: Standing and crouch starts, reaction games.

sessions.name: Club group session
sessions.description: Mixed session with your training group: relays, races and games.

sessions.name: Strength & core
sessions.description: Bodyweight circuit, core and light gym work.

sessions.name: Running drills
sessions.description: Skips, A-march and bounding drills for better form.

sessions.name: Mobility & stretching
sessions.description: Stretching, foam rolling and mobility work. Helps recovery.

sessions.name: Cross-country skiing
sessions.description: 60–90 min on the ski trails. A big engine without the pounding.

coach_plan._note: The club coach's starter week for a 14-year-old 800 m runner (autumn base phase). Mon..Sun, max 2 sessions per day.
